name: Black Box Spatial
story: Esther Baumann used Black Box Spatial’s affiliation in GISList correspondence during 2010–11. She shared advice on mountain-range labels and annotation, and sought ArcScene symbols for New Zealand trees and vegetation. These messages document the firm’s participation in practical GIS and cartographic discussions.

sources.label: Esther Baumann, Black Box Spatial, GISList: Mountain Range Labels, 10 June 2010
